about_short_description.short_description: Cardinal Gray is a software financial company that develops titling tools for auto lenders using artificial intelligence.

product.name: Workflow Automation Tools
product.description: Software tools designed to automate and accelerate title work for auto lenders and dealerships, improving accuracy and reducing manual effort.

product.name: Intelligent Form Generation
product.description: Automatically generates all required DMV forms for title perfection by using real-time owner and lien data specific to each state.

product.name: State-Specific Signature Collection
product.description: Collects required signatures and powers of attorney in compliance with DMV regulations across all 50 states.

product.name: Comprehensive, Real-Time DMV Data Integration
product.description: Provides access to up-to-date DMV records and cross-references loan data to confirm liens and identify title issues.

product.name: Consolidated Account Records Management
product.description: Synchronizes loan management, electronic lien tracking, and scanned mail data to maintain comprehensive and up-to-date title records.
